feeds.title: Scandi Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: ScandiKitchen is UK's leading Scandinavian food outlets, providing freshly made food and groceries from Scandinavia. We are all about bringing the best of Nordic cuisine to you whether you've got time to join us in the café or need to get back to your desk.

feeds.title: Call Me Cupcake
feeds.description: Hello everyone! I'm Linda. I live in the little town I grew up in, in the south of Sweden. In 2009 I discovered how incredibly fun baking could be. I quickly became obsessed with cupcakes and wanted to share my experiences with people then I started this blog. And I needed pictures to run a blog of course. After studying photography in high school, I had a camera that I barely used. So when I started baking, I also started taking pictures of my baked goods.

feeds.title: Scandinavia Standard » Food & Drink
feeds.description: From New Nordic cuisine to traditional Scandinavian recipes, we've got a taste for everyone. Find out what restaurants to try in Copenhagen, where to get the best brunch in Stockholm, and so much more.

feeds.title: Nordic Food & Living Blog
feeds.description: A glimpse of our Nordic life's. Seen mostly through food. Find recipes with a Nordic twist & pictures from our life in Denmark.

feeds.title: North Wild Kitchen
feeds.description: Covers articles about seasonal cooking, local ingredients, local artisans, Norwegian traditions, stories, recipes, seasons and history. North Wild Kitchen is a Norwegian cooking blog at its simplest and most elaborate.

feeds.title: The Nordic Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: The Nordic Kitchen is a blog devoted to seasonal cooking, finding beauty in everyday moments, and enjoying food that is good for us and the planet. Here you'll find plant-based recipes, travel stories, posts about natural beauty, and stories about my life in Sweden.

feeds.title: Green Kitchen Stories
feeds.description: Welcome to our Green Kitchen. Here we cook and eat healthy and simple vegetarian food with natural ingredients, whole grains, good fats, fruit, and vegetables. Also, read about our travels where we have gathered some of our travel guides and photos and posts about the kids.

feeds.title: My Danish Kitchen
feeds.description: My name is Gitte and Im from Denmark. I live in the US with my wonderful family and I enjoy recreating classic, as well as modern Danish recipes and also trying out other Scandinavian and American dishes. I hope this blog will be helpful to anyone wanting to bake Scandinavian recipes.

feeds.title: Karlas Nordic Kitchen
feeds.description: Karlas Nordic Kitchen is a food blog full of easy tasty recipes, low carb healthy vegetarian recipes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Also, find various easy dessert recipes all with a Nordic twist.

feeds.title: The Johan Blog
feeds.description: Personal website of Johan Johansen - food blogger, self-proclaimed resturant critic, avid home chef, wine lover, metal head and a geek of many words. You will find recipes, culinary history, restaurant reviews and wine blurbs

feeds.title: Foods of Copenhagen Blog
feeds.description: Go beyond regular food tours and meet your local friend. Come with Foods of Copenhagen on a personal and guided walking or biking food tour held by local, passionate Copenhageners. Experience Copenhagen's delicious food and learn about Copenhagen's history and Danish culture.
